cites.quote: Given a patient with 4 Completed, 1 No-show, 2 Cancelled and 1 Scheduled appointment that starts after now
An appointment called off before it took place, with a reason
Scheduled appointments that start after now

findings.text: No AC has a Cancelled appointment that starts after now. The likeliest wrong upcoming count (any appointment with start > now, whatever its status) passes every S-1 AC. Per the glossary, Cancelled appointments can lie in the future.

cites.quote: Given a patient whose only Completed appointment starts at 19:30 UTC on 9 March 2026
Given a patient whose last Completed appointment is on 01 Nov 2026
start date of the patient's most recent Completed appointment in the hospital time zone

findings.text: Every S-3 AC has a single Completed appointment, or leaves the older ones unspecified. Picking the earliest or first-loaded Completed row passes all of them, so no AC proves that the most recent Completed appointment is chosen (REQ-8, REQ-9).
